node.statement: Provider and receiving-witness selection: after fixing c0 from lem-maincb-error-improvement, fix L,e_env from lem-maincb-direct-corner-envelope for this c0, C_corner_unit,e_corner_unit from lem-maincb-compressed-corner-unit-comparison, D_1^0,e_1^0 from lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement, C_sc,e_sc from lem-compcb-single-compression-transfer, C_rect,e_rect from lem-compcb-rectangular-product, and C_proj,e_proj,C_np,e_np,C_pair,e_pair from the three named Stage-1 producers. Choose K_1^0 at least max{1,c0+1,L,C_sc*(c0+1),C_proj*L,C_np*L,C_pair*L}; choose e_1>0 no larger than min{e_1^0,e_corner_unit,e_env,e_sc,e_rect/2,e_proj,e_np,e_pair,1}; and choose D_1 at least D_1^0 and every finite coefficient occurring in the unit telescopes and the m=1 ambient-product transfer below. These choices are positive finite universal, absorb every displayed provider threshold and coefficient, and have e_1<=min{e_1^0,e_corner_unit}.
